projects.name: CrossFlow
projects.summary: LAN-based clipboard synchronization tool enabling seamless copy-paste across Windows, Android, and macOS devices via TCP/mDNS auto-discovery. Zero-config, no cloud, peer-to-peer architecture with bidirectional 100-500ms sync latency.

projects.name: The Artist Room
projects.summary: Production-ready SaaS platform for artist profile management and music submissions. Features full-stack architecture with artist authentication, profile management, music submission workflows, Spotify API integration, subscription billing via Stripe, and comprehensive admin dashboard.
